name: device-code-account-picker
title: Device code flow with account picker and scroll-gated authorize
description: Template: CLI prints a device code, browser opens the device page, account is pre-selected, code is pasted via ClipboardEvent, authorize button requires scroll to enable
preconditions: Verify comet-cdp is up (port 9222) — run: comet-cdp status
Verify the CLI tool is installed and available in PATH
Run: <cli> login --device — it prints a URL and a XXXX-XXXX code

vars.name: user_code
vars.description: The XXXX-XXXX device code displayed by the CLI

vars.name: account
vars.description: Account username or email to select when multiple accounts are logged in

steps.rationale: Open the device code entry page using the browser profile (already authenticated)
steps.on_failure: If redirected to login page, the saved session has expired — re-authenticate manually, then retry

steps.rationale: Capture the page state — may redirect to account picker or show code input directly
If no account selection needed and code input is visible, fill it directly
steps.condition: page shows 'User code' textbox and URL does not contain 'select_account'

then.rationale: Capture the code entry page with individual textboxes
Paste the full device code via ClipboardEvent — the page's JS distributes it across individual textboxes

steps.rationale: Only appears when multiple accounts are logged in to the browser
steps.condition: URL contains 'select_account' or multiple account buttons visible

then.rationale: Capture the code entry page with individual textboxes
Paste the full device code via ClipboardEvent — the page's JS distributes it across individual textboxes

steps.rationale: Confirm the 'Authorize your device' prompt is showing
Scroll to bottom to enable the Authorize button, then click it

then.rationale: Scroll to bottom — the Authorize button is disabled until the user scrolls down
Brief wait for button state to update
Re-snapshot after scroll — Authorize button should be enabled
Approve the OAuth request — grants the CLI tool access

steps.rationale: If 'Use passkey' button is shown, click it to trigger the password manager's passkey iframe (e.g. Proton Pass)
steps.condition: page shows 'Use passkey' button or passkey iframe with buttons containing the site domain

then.rationale: Click 'Use passkey' if the button is shown (not auto-triggered)
Click 'Use passkey' to trigger the password manager iframe
Wait for the passkey iframe to appear
Capture the password manager passkey iframe
Click the first passkey in the iframe
Wait for passkey authentication to complete

steps.rationale: Verify success — page should show confirmation text or redirect away from /login/device

success_signal: page text contains 'successfully' or 'authorized' or 'Congratulations' or 'all set'
